Name: Mercedes AMG GT3 (LMU + iRacing)
Author: Redadeg (lmu-dashboards.com)
Description: Converted for the FX Pro by FX Unleashed from Redadeg's SimHub dash "LMGT3 Mercedes AMG GT3" (https://lmu-dashboards.com). One dash for Le Mans Ultimate and iRacing: it follows the game SimHub reports (iRacing: T WATER, V BATT, T OIL and T GEAR boxes, TC2 / TC3, track wetness, headlight flash). Parts flip on their own, as in the original: the lap time box (lap time, last lap, predicted, best: Next page 1), the tyres over the left boxes (pressures and temperatures, brakes: Next page 2) and the flag bars at the sides (Next page 3). Runs best with the screen's RAM drive (Wheel tab).
